**Summary**


Resideo announced the First Alert® L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor & Shutoff Valve, expanding its First Alert smart water portfolio with micro-leak sensing, whole-home usage monitoring and automatic shutoff capabilities. The L7 combines AI-powered intelligent leak detection and water-use analytics to help homeowners identify water issues early, with the ability to detect leaks as small as four drops per hour and automatically stop water flow to help limit damage.


# Resideo Introduces AI-Powered Water Intelligence with New First Alert® L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor & Shutoff Valve


## New smart water solution monitors home water activity and uses AI to identify unusual patterns and micro-leaks, helping identify water issues earlier


[Company News](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/corporate/newsroom/all-articles/#f:tags=[Company%20News])


[Water](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/corporate/newsroom/all-articles/#f:tags=[Water])


11/17/26


**SCOTTSDALE, Ariz.** (Nov. 17, 2026) –[Resideo Technologies](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/resideo-home/) (NYSE: REZI), a leading global provider of solutions for home comfort, security and safety, today announced the[First Alert® L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor & Shutoff Valve](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/products/water/potable-water-solutions/leak-detection/l7-smart-water-flow-monitor-shutoff-valve-3-4-in-npt-ball-valve-vws03y-3-4/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=L7_announcement) . The new AI-powered solution applies nearly a decade of water-use analytics to detect unusual water-use patterns that may signal a water leak and can automatically shut off a home's water. The latest addition to Resideo’s award-winning[First Alert L Series](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/lseries/) expands the company’s smart water portfolio with micro-leak detection, whole-home usage monitoring and intelligent insights designed to help homeowners, service professionals and insurers move from reacting to water damage to identifying potential problems before they become major losses.


“Water damage claims are among the most common and costly losses facing homeowners and insurers,” said Paul Vacquier, Chief Executive Officer of Beagle Services, a leading national provider of smart water security and plumbing services who recently added the L7 to its product offering to homeowners and uses[Resideo Pro-IQ™ Analyze](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/products/air/services/pro-iqt-analyze-proiqal1/) for remote monitoring. “Resideo's First Alert water-loss mitigation solution helps shift the focus from responding to water damage after a loss occurs to identifying issues earlier and potentially reducing the impact. That intelligence offers a meaningful benefit for homeowners, insurance carriers and restoration professionals.”


The L7 builds on Resideo's nearly decade-long investment in water intelligence, combining connected-home expertise, water-use analytics and relationships with insurance providers and professional installers to identify water risks earlier. Powered by[Resideo Pro-IQ services](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/proiq/) , which enables service professionals to provide ongoing monitoring and maintenance beyond the initial installation, the L7 also reflects Resideo's broader strategy to help shift home protection from reactive response toward proactive prevention.


### AI-Powered Insights for Proactive Home Protection


The First Alert L7 learns household water-use patterns and uses AI to help identify unusual activity, detect micro-leaks and filter out false-positive alerts while providing actionable notifications for events that require attention. When a water leak is detected, the L7 can automatically shut off the water to help limit damage.


“At Resideo, we are using our deep domain expertise, insights and technology to move the connected home from reacting to problems to anticipating them,” said Pat Tessier, Vice President of Product Management at Resideo. “By identifying unusual patterns that may signal a developing issue, we’re giving homeowners more time to act and helping prevent costly damage before it happens.”


### Whole-Home Visibility


To help detect issues earlier and mitigate damage from water leaks, the L7 offers several layers of protection:


- **Dual-sensing micro-leak detection.** Combining turbine sensing to measure water-flow activity with pressure sensing, the L7 can detect leaks as small as four drops per hour, helping identify issues that might otherwise go unnoticed.
- **Automatic water shutoff.** When qualifying leak conditions are met, the L7 can automatically stop water flow to help limit damage.
- **Real-time alerts.** Homeowners are informed when leaks or unusual water activity are detected through audible and visual alerts on the device and in the[Resideo Connect app](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-connect-app/) . Through the[Resideo One portal](https://pro.resideo.com/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=L7_announcement) , professional partners can receive micro-leak test results and alerts to proactively address a leak risk.
- **Manual valve control.** As an added safeguard, users have multiple ways to control the valve, including through the Resideo Connect app or directly on the device using the power button or actuator lever.
- **Backup power.** Common AA battery backup helps maintain core functionality during power outages for up to 24 hours.


### Availability


The L7 integrates with compatible[First Alert L Series](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/lseries/) solutions, providing comprehensive water-leak monitoring and optional automatic water shutoff capabilities to help protect the whole home. Thoughtfully designed for indoor or outdoor installation and in collaboration with insurance providers, the solution is well suited for insurance and water-risk mitigation programs, as well as property management, multifamily housing and new construction. Product owners also may be eligible for insurance discounts or rebates through participating carriers. For more information, visit[Resideo.com](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/products/water/potable-water-solutions/leak-detection/l7-smart-water-flow-monitor-shutoff-valve-3-4-in-npt-ball-valve-vws03y-3-4/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=L7_announcement) .


# # #


### About Resideo


Resideo is a global building technologies company that is a leading developer and manufacturer of critical control and sensing solutions for residential markets. The company serves professional installers and integrators across diverse product categories, such as heating, ventilation and air conditioning controls, combustion, life safety, security and water. Its comfort and protection solutions can be found in more than 150 million residential and commercial spaces globally, with tens of millions of new devices sold annually. More information about Resideo and its trusted brands, including BRK, First Alert and Honeywell Home, is available at[Resideo.com](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/resideo-home/) .


Using the[Resideo Pro-IQ™ Analyze](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/proiq/) , professional service partners can monitor the L7 remotely, giving them greater visibility into system performance and helping identify potential issues before they require an on-site visit.


The First Alert L7 continuously evaluates household water-use patterns, learns behavior and can distinguish normal activity from potentially abnormal events, providing meaningful alerts and insights.


Designed for professional installation in a home's main water line, the First Alert L7 has an optional outdoor enclosure that expands installation flexibility for exterior applications.


Homeowners are informed when leaks or unusual water activity are detected through audible and visual alerts on the device and in the[Resideo Connect app](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/resideo-connect-app/) .


## Frequently Asked Questions


**What is the First Alert® L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor & Shutoff Valve?**


The[First Alert L7 Smart Water Flow Monitor & Shutoff Valve](https://www.resideo.com/us/en/pro/products/water/potable-water-solutions/leak-detection/l7-smart-water-flow-monitor-shutoff-valve-3-4-in-npt-ball-valve-vws03y-3-4/?utm_source=pr&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=L7_announcement) is the most comprehensive smart water solution in the L Series portfolio. With easy professional installation, it combines whole-home water-flow monitoring, intelligent leak detection, water-use insights and optional automatic water shutoff in one connected solution. This premium product must be professionally installed, and it can be professionally monitored.


**How does the First Alert L7 help detect water leaks?**


The First Alert L7 uses dual-sensing micro-leak detection technology that combines flow and pressure sensing to help detect leaks as small as four drops per hour. The adaptive-learning system shares analytics with users through the Resideo Connect app, while continuously monitoring water activity and identifying unusual water-use patterns that may signal a developing issue.


**How does the First Alert L7 use AI?**


The First Alert L7 features AI-powered water-use analysis that utilizes nearly a decade of water-use analytics that measure how water flows through various styles of homes, the flow rate of various appliances and hardware (i.e., sink, shower, washing machine). It begins detecting potential water issues from day one with built-in, standard detection thresholds. Then, over several weeks, it uses adaptive-learning intelligence to understand household water-use patterns and evaluate normal activity. After establishing a benchmark of what normal water usage looks like, it can spot patterns that may indicate unusual water use or a potential leak to provide meaningful alerts while reducing unnecessary notifications that can contribute to alert fatigue. This also helps tailor leak warnings and automatic shutoff behavior to a user’s typical usage.


**Can the First Alert L7 automatically shut off water?**


Yes. Users have the option to enable the L7 to automatically shut off if qualifying leak conditions are detected. Professional partners enrolled in Pro-IQ Analyze services also can monitor and shut off the water for the homeowner.


**How does the First Alert L7 work with other First Alert L Series products?**


The First Alert L7 expands the L Series Smart Water Solutions portfolio utilizing nearly a decade of water flow analytics and AI to help protect the whole home from water leak damage. The L7 works with First Alert L Series products to extend water-risk awareness throughout the home. For example, if a First Alert L1 or L2 sensor detects a leak before the L7, the L1 or L2 will send an alert and the L7 can automatically shut off the water, based on a user’s settings.


**Who is the First Alert L7 designed for?**


The First Alert L7 is designed for professional installation and is well suited for homeowners, insurance and water-risk mitigation programs, property management applications, multifamily communities and new construction projects.


**Why is the First Alert L7 valuable for insurance providers?**


Water damage and freezing claims make up about[a quarter of all home insurance claims](https://www.usnews.com/insurance/homeowners-insurance/most-common-claims) and have an[average claim amount of $15,400 in damage](https://www.usnews.com/insurance/homeowners-insurance/most-common-claims) . The First Alert L7 is designed to detect unusual water patterns early and help stop damage before it happens. With optional automatic shutoff capabilities, it gives insurance customers peace of mind. Some insurance companies offer discounts for homeowners who install water leak detection solutions in their homes.


**Does the First Alert L7 provide whole-home water monitoring?**


Yes. Installed in a home's main water line, the First Alert L7 monitors water activity throughout the entire plumbing system, providing whole-home visibility rather than monitoring a single location. The L7 also works with First Alert L Series products to extend water-risk awareness throughout the home. Powered by Pro-IQ services, the professional also can monitor and shut off the water for the homeowner.
